checkpoint.validation: All indexed tensors, shard assignments, contiguous offsets and dtype/shape bytes verified; all backbone routed expert and Engram table shapes checked against config.
checkpoint.scope: Downloaded headers only; tensor values and numerical inference not validated. File storage is not runtime residency.

non_matrix.excluded: Sparse softmax/index reduction/sorting, quantization and source casts/copies are not included in this scalar subtotal; full MATRIX graph is independently complete.

state_before.scope: Logical populated KV/index/SWA + allocated FP32 compressor slots + populated int64 Engram token IDs; excludes weights, workspace, static RoPE/token-map tables and allocator. Production changes KV encoding, retaining reference compressor/hash state for comparison.

state_after.scope: Logical populated KV/index/SWA + allocated FP32 compressor slots + populated int64 Engram token IDs; excludes weights, workspace, static RoPE/token-map tables and allocator. Production changes KV encoding, retaining reference compressor/hash state for comparison.

production_state_after.scope: Logical populated KV/index/SWA + allocated FP32 compressor slots + populated int64 Engram token IDs; excludes weights, workspace, static RoPE/token-map tables and allocator. Production changes KV encoding, retaining reference compressor/hash state for comparison.

coverage.scalar_scope: Logical norms, RoPE, gates, reductions, mHC and pooling; no quantization/backend instruction total
excluded: DSpark speculative entry point (ordinary autoregressive generation)
quantization, sorting algorithms, compiled tile padding, actual HBM and latency

assumptions: All text parameters include Engram tables and projections; exclude vision, DSpark and quantization scales. Shapes validated against all 48 pinned checkpoint headers.

Reference: all 40 layers over fresh prompt, rectangular index einsum before causal/candidate masking. CED: 20 encoder layers over all prompt positions, decoder KV/index-key projection over all positions, 20 decoder layers over last min(P,128) positions.

CED decoder SWA replay truncates local attention to the replay segment; it reconstructs approximate states, not mathematically identical full-prefix states (paper 3.2.2). Global attention remains causal with original absolute positions.
Candidate index mode counts causally reachable entries; later decoder indexers scan at most 16384 entries. Selection/pooling comparisons are not matrix FLOPs.
One call with history>0 requires one token, matching the released source. Chunked prefix continuation and encoder cache-miss replay are not modeled by this entry point.
Matrix FLOPs use FMA=2 and effective sparse pairs; scalar/special work is reported separately. These are resource demands, not measured time or throughput.
